name: Itaike na Kanojo
source: As part of punishment for a losing a bet, Takumi Akiyoshi is told to confess to the class bully victim as a joke and become a couple with her. He thinks of it as annoying but she ends up responding to it very seriously and clings to him with desperate determination.
